messages.content:
You are generating domain context profiles for AI risk variation axes.

For each variation axis (an ontology class), you are given candidate classes that form the enumeration space — the specific values that can be substituted when generating diverse prompts.

Candidates may be subclasses (specializations) or siblings (parallel concepts at the same level). Both are valid enumeration values.

Filter out irrelevant candidates and annotate each remaining one with:
- relevance: "high" (directly relevant), "medium" (potentially relevant), "low" (edge case)

Return one entry per axis using the axis URI as a key, with the filtered enumerations.

Risk: IP information in prompt (ID: atlas-ip-information-in-prompt)
Description: Copyrighted information or other intellectual property might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
Concern: Inclusion of such data might result in it being disclosed in the model output. In addition to accidental disclosure, prompt data might be used for other purposes like model evaluation and retraining, and might appear in their output if not properly removed.
Policy: Proprietary Technical Data

Axis: context (https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/ContextualDesignators/Context)
Roles: location
Subclasses:
  - https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/RegulatoryAgencies/Jurisdiction: jurisdiction
  - https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/SitesAndFacilities/Site: site
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/LOAN/LoansSpecific/GreenLoans/AssessmentBoundary: assessment boundary
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/Process/FinancialContextAndProcess/FinancialIndustryContext: financial industry context

Axis: authorising party (https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/BusinessAuthorizations/AuthorizingParty)
Roles: agent
Ontology constraints:
  - someValuesFrom: isPlayedBy -> LegalPerson
  - someValuesFrom: authorizesThrough -> Authorization
Subclasses:
  - https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/RegulatoryAgencies/RegulatoryAgency: regulatory agency
  - https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/RegistrationAuthorities/RegistrationAuthority: registration authority

Axis: authorised party (https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/BusinessAuthorizations/AuthorizedParty)
Roles: agent, instrument
Ontology constraints:
  - someValuesFrom: isPlayedBy -> LegalPerson
  - someValuesFrom: isAuthorizedThrough -> Authorization
Subclasses:
  - https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/BusinessAuthorizations/LegallyDelegatedAuthority: legally delegated authority
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BE/OwnershipAndControl/Executives/Auditor: auditor
  - https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/BusinessAuthorizations/ResponsibleParty: responsible party

Axis: disclosure provision (https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Agreements/Contracts/DisclosureProvision)
Roles: object
Siblings:
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Debt/ExerciseConventions/ExerciseTerms: exercise terms
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Agreements/Contracts/TerminationProvision: termination provision
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Agreements/Contracts/NettingProvision: netting provision
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Agreements/Contracts/ExtensionProvision: extension provision
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/ProductsAndServices/FinancialProductsAndServices/SettlementTerms: settlement terms
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FinancialInstruments/FinancialInstruments/RedemptionProvision: redemption provision
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Agreements/Contracts/UseOfProceedsProvision: use of proceeds provision
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Agreements/Contracts/NotificationProvision: notification provision
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesRestrictions/ContractualRestriction: contractual restriction
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt/DebtTerms: debt terms
